acceptanceCriteria: Export is an explicit command producing deterministic bytes for the same admitted trace.
Each exported skill names its admission evidence digest and evaluation result; unadmitted traces cannot be exported.
A host round-trip fixture loads the exported skill.
body: Owner requested the 2026-09 state-of-the-art gap review items as part of Corvint 0.7.0 on 2026-09-22. This ticket records release intent, not delivery or promotion. Original Go implementation; extend the cited existing mechanisms and preserve the existing public wires. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Current state: admitted learned traces have no export format consumable by hosts. Add an explicit export of admitted rules as SKILL.md documents with progressive disclosure, carrying the admission evidence digest so the exported skill can be traced back to its evaluation. Owning spec: docs/specs/learned-trace-admission-v0.md.
title: learning: export admitted learned rules as SKILL.md progressive-disclosure documents
